scope: PhiAgent-Bench v0.1 clean-room H2R, action, simulation, real-audit, and leaderboard infrastructure
summary: The dependency-light PhiAgent-Bench v0.1 software path is implemented and acceptance-tested, while official H2R assets, a heavyweight RoboWM simulation run, and new real-robot trials remain absent.
evidence: The corrected smoke run closes L1-L5, reports H2RCore 94.625 from the same three structured H2R judge fixtures, and writes suite, submission, report, Git state, host, packages, policy seed, and command under runs/phiagent-bench/20260831T140000Z-smoke-v0.1-corrected.
The public RM65 preview imports the measured 192/192-frame IK replay but reports complete=false, L4=0.0, and E2E valid real success=0.0 under runs/phiagent-bench/20260831T140000Z-public-preview-v0.1.

Fifteen focused benchmark, recorded-real-evidence, evaluation-statistics, and simulator-interface tests pass; the optional MuJoCo test skips because the lightweight local environment has no mujoco package.

The full CPU suite reports 956 passed, 3 skipped, and 2 unrelated pre-existing failures: ffmpeg/ffprobe are absent from PATH, and the main-branch JoyAI server command omits a timeout flag expected by its test. This change does not modify those files.

Targeted Ruff and git diff whitespace checks pass; the external RoboWM-Bench checkout preflight matches revision 0a8b0eab3ebfb7993f6ab895f12eac41dfefa1c1 and emits its pinned one-episode evaluation command.
lessons: H2R visual equations, source action truth, simulator task outcome, complete physical gates, and recorded hardware success must remain separate evidence types.
A dual-arm action score should conservatively expose the weakest arm so one accurate trajectory cannot hide the other arm's error.
Exact suite coverage and end-to-end denominators prevent simulation rejection or missing real trials from being cherry-picked away.
Smoke fixtures must be generated from the same structured judge outputs used by the standalone scorer; acceptance caught and corrected an inconsistent hand-entered M2 value.
limitations: H2R-Bench has not published its evaluator code or 120-clip annotations at the pinned revision, so this is a clean-room reproduction of public paper equations, not official score parity.
RoboWM-Bench requires Isaac Sim 5.1, Isaac Lab, GPU resources, and task actions; only revision preflight, command construction, and fail-closed result parsing ran locally.
M5 model inference and three production judge backends have not run on a released PhiAgent case.
No new blind-reviewed real-robot trial exists, and the checked-in RM65 adapter is evidence-only with hardware execution disabled.
next_actions: Freeze a redistributable multi-family source suite and author H2R predicates/events without exposing test annotations to generation.
Run RoboWM-Bench on a GPU Isaac Lab 5.1 host and add complete collision, velocity, singularity, contact, and task-success evidence rather than only upstream task outcome.
Collect repeated, blind-reviewed trials through one execution-enabled hardware adapter and publish Coverage, RealPrecisionLowerBound, E2E-VSR, confidence intervals, and valid-data goodput.
